parts.title: The Captains Clue and the Bus Trap

series.summary: Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio arrive at Port Dolle. Following the captains clue, Gon and Kurapika take the mountain path while Leorio narrowly avoids a fraudulent bus trap.

segments.voiceover_text: Gon steps onto the docks of Port Dolle with his map in hand. Following the sea captains advice, he sets his sights on the lone cedar tree on the mountain.
Leorio laughs at the idea of a brutal hike. He points eagerly to a direct bus to Zaban City, convinced he found the easy way.
Kurapika follows Gon anyway. But when Leorio overhears that the bus is a trap to eliminate lazy applicants, he panics and sprints up the road to catch them.
Reunited on the trail, the trio enters an eerily silent town, completely unaware of the ambush waiting ahead.

parts.title: The Abandoned Town and the Two Choice Quiz

series.summary: In a deserted town, an eerie examiner tests applicants with an unforgiving two-choice quiz. Arrogant applicant Matthew answers selfishly and is led into a lethal beast den.

segments.voiceover_text: Bizarre masked figures emerge from the shadows as an elderly examiner blocks the road. She presents an unforgiving two-choice quiz: one wrong answer means instant disqualification.
An arrogant applicant named Matthew, who was secretly stalking them, shoves his way to the front to take the test first.
The examiner poses the riddle: villains hold your mother and your lover captive. Which one do you save? Matthew confidently picks his mother, arguing lovers can always be replaced.
The examiner sends him through a side door. But Matthew walked right into a den of ravenous beasts—and now the examiner points her finger directly at Gons trio.

parts.title: The Impossible Riddle and the Silence Answer

series.summary: Faced with a cruel question between saving a son or daughter, Leorio nearly attacks the examiner before Kurapika stops him, proving silence is the only acceptable answer.

segments.voiceover_text: The examiner drops an impossible dilemma: if kidnappers take your son and daughter, which child do you rescue? They have five seconds to choose.
As the timer ticks down, Leorio snaps. Furious at the cruel riddle, he grabs a heavy wooden club and charges to strike the examiner down.
Kurapika blocks the blow at the final second with his twin wooden blades. Silence was the true answer—and the examiner chimes the buzzer, passing them all.
While the others celebrate, Gon sits frozen in thought, troubled by what he would do if life ever forced him to make that choice.

parts.title: The Cabin Attack and the Kiriko Chase

series.summary: At the lone cedar tree, the boys discover a ransacked cabin where a monstrous Kiriko beast kidnaps a woman. Leorio tends to the wounded husband while Gon pursues the monster.

segments.voiceover_text: Following the examiners directions through dense mountain fog, the trio reaches the towering cedar tree and discovers an isolated cabin.
Inside, a gruesome scene awaits: a man lies bleeding on the floor, while a ferocious winged beast clutches a screaming woman.
The beast smashes through the window into the woods. Leorio stays behind to bandage the dying husband, while Gon and Kurapika sprint in pursuit.

Leaping through the trees, Gon whips his fishing rod forward, smashing the monster across the face and freeing the captive woman. But as the creature flees into a clearing, Gon notices something bizarre about its face.

parts.title: The Shapeshifter Secret and the True Flight

series.summary: Gon distinguishes the two identical beasts while Kurapika discovers the truth about the woman. The Kiriko reveal they are exam navigators and fly the trio toward Zaban City.

segments.voiceover_text: Gon corners the monster in a clearing, but notices something strange. Looking closely, he realizes this beasts face and voice are different from the one he struck earlier.
Kurapika arrives with the woman, while Leorio carries the bandaged husband. The monsters drop their act and reveal they are the Kiriko, shapeshifters conducting the official Navigator exam.
The Kiriko praise Kurapikas sharp intellect, Leorios selfless medical compassion, and Gons uncanny instincts. All three applicants have officially passed.
Spreading their massive wings, the Kiriko carry Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio into the skies, soaring directly toward Zaban City for the real Hunter Exam.
